228public:
230 void AddSubjectPrimitive(const FPrimitiveSceneInfo* PrimitiveSceneInfo, int32 PrimitiveId)
231 {
232 checkSlow(PrimitiveSceneInfo->GetIndex() == PrimitiveId);
233 const int32 PrimitiveIndex = PrimitiveSceneInfo->GetIndex();
234 if (!ShadowSubjectPrimitivesEncountered[PrimitiveId])
235 {
236 ShadowSubjectPrimitives.Add(PrimitiveSceneInfo);
237 ShadowSubjectPrimitivesEncountered[PrimitiveId] = true;
238 }
239 }
240
242 const TArray<const FPrimitiveSceneInfo*, SceneRenderingAllocator>& GetShadowSubjectPrimitives() const
243 {
244 return ShadowSubjectPrimitives;
245 }
246

250 {
251 ShadowSubjectPrimitivesEncountered.Init(false, PrimitiveCount);
252 }
253
254protected:
256 FSceneBitArray ShadowSubjectPrimitivesEncountered;
257 TArray<const FPrimitiveSceneInfo*, SceneRenderingAllocator> ShadowSubjectPrimitives;
258};

321// Stores the primitive count of each translucency pass (redundant, could be computed after sorting but this way we touch less memory)
322struct FTranslucenyPrimCount
323{
324private:
325 uint32 Count[ETranslucencyPass::TPT_MAX];
326 bool UseSceneColorCopyPerPass[ETranslucencyPass::TPT_MAX];
327
328public:
329 // constructor
330 FTranslucenyPrimCount()
331 {
332 for(uint32 i = 0; i < ETranslucencyPass::TPT_MAX; ++i)
333 {
334 Count[i] = 0;
335 UseSceneColorCopyPerPass[i] = false;
336 }
337 }
338
339 // interface similar to TArray but here we only store the count of Prims per pass
340 void Append(const FTranslucenyPrimCount& InSrc)
341 {
342 for(uint32 i = 0; i < ETranslucencyPass::TPT_MAX; ++i)
343 {
344 Count[i] += InSrc.Count[i];
345 UseSceneColorCopyPerPass[i] |= InSrc.UseSceneColorCopyPerPass[i];
346 }
347 }
348
349 // interface similar to TArray but here we only store the count of Prims per pass
350 void Add(ETranslucencyPass::Type InPass, bool bUseSceneColorCopy)
351 {
352 ++Count[InPass];
353 UseSceneColorCopyPerPass[InPass] |= bUseSceneColorCopy;
354 }
355
356 int32 Num(ETranslucencyPass::Type InPass) const
357 {
358 return Count[InPass];
359 }
360
361 int32 NumPrims() const
362 {
363 int32 NumTotal = 0;
364 for (uint32 PassIndex = 0; PassIndex < ETranslucencyPass::TPT_MAX; ++PassIndex)
365 {
366 NumTotal += Count[PassIndex];
367 }
368 return NumTotal;
369 }
370
371 bool UseSceneColorCopy(ETranslucencyPass::Type InPass) const
372 {
373 return UseSceneColorCopyPerPass[InPass];
374 }
375};

901static const int32 GMaxNumReflectionCaptures = 341;

903// Maximum number of concurrent runtime-reflection-capture smooth blends (cubemap-array slots reserved as blend
904// sources, plus the corresponding shader-side blend table size). Actual blend slot count is defined in
905// r.ReflectionCapture.Runtime.SmoothBlendSlots, and clamped to this value.

912 // W is smooth blend info for runtime captures -- integer portion is source cube map index, fractional is blend, with 0 representing no active blend
913 SHADER_PARAMETER_ARRAY(FVector4f,PositionLow,[GMaxNumReflectionCaptures])
914 // R is brightness, G is array index, B is shape, A is the fade-in alpha (0..1) for runtime captures
915 SHADER_PARAMETER_ARRAY(FVector4f,CaptureProperties,[GMaxNumReflectionCaptures])
916 SHADER_PARAMETER_ARRAY(FVector4f,CaptureOffsetAndAverageBrightness,[GMaxNumReflectionCaptures])

942// Structure in charge of storing all information about TAA's history.
943struct FTemporalAAHistory
944{
945 // Number of render target in the history.
946 static constexpr int32 kRenderTargetCount = 2;
947
948 // Render targets holding's pixel history.
949 // scene color's RGBA are in OutputRT[0].
950 TStaticArray<TRefCountPtr<IPooledRenderTarget>, kRenderTargetCount> RT;
951
952 // Reference size of RT. Might be different than RT's actual size to handle down res.
953 FIntPoint ReferenceBufferSize;
954
955 // Viewport coordinate of the history in RT according to ReferenceBufferSize.
956 FIntRect ViewportRect;
957
958 // Returns the slice index that contains the output in RT[0].
959 int32 OutputSliceIndex = 0;
960
961
962 void SafeRelease()
963 {
964 *this = FTemporalAAHistory();
965 }
966
967 bool IsValid() const
968 {
969 return RT[0].IsValid();
970 }
971
972 uint64 GetGPUSizeBytes(bool bLogSizes) const;
973};
974
975// Structure in charge of storing all information about TSR's history.
976struct FTSRHistory
977{
978 // Output resolution.
979 TRefCountPtr<IPooledRenderTarget> ColorArray;
980 TRefCountPtr<IPooledRenderTarget> MetadataArray;
981
982 // Input resolution representation of the output
983 TRefCountPtr<IPooledRenderTarget> GuideArray;
984 TRefCountPtr<IPooledRenderTarget> MoireArray;
985 TRefCountPtr<IPooledRenderTarget> CoverageArray;
986
987 // Frame's input and output resolution.
988 FIntRect InputViewportRect;
989 FIntRect OutputViewportRect;
990
991 // Format of the history for auto camera cut when setting change.
992 uint32 FormatBit = 0;
993
994 // Number of frame in history.
995 int32 FrameStorageCount = 1;
996 int32 FrameStoragePeriod = 1;
997 int32 AccumulatedFrameCount = 1;
998 int32 LastFrameRollingIndex = 0;
999
1000 // All the information the previous frames for resurrection.
1001 TArray<FViewMatrices> ViewMatrices;
1002 TArray<float> SceneColorPreExposures;
1003 TArray<FIntRect> InputViewportRects;
1004 TArray<TRefCountPtr<IPooledRenderTarget>> DistortingDisplacementTextures;
1005
1006
1007 void SafeRelease()
1008 {
1009 *this = FTSRHistory();
1010 }
1011
1012 bool IsValid() const
1013 {
1014 return MetadataArray.IsValid();
1015 }
1016
1017 uint64 GetGPUSizeBytes(bool bLogSizes) const;
1018};

1021struct FScreenSpaceDenoiserHistory

1966class FShadowMapRenderTargetsRefCounted
1967{
1968public:
1969 // This structure gets included in FCachedShadowMapData, so avoid SceneRenderingAllocator use!
1970 TArray<TRefCountPtr<IPooledRenderTarget>, TInlineAllocator<4>> ColorTargets;
1971 TRefCountPtr<IPooledRenderTarget> DepthTarget;
1972
1973 bool IsValid() const
1974 {
1975 if (DepthTarget)
1976 {
1977 return true;
1978 }
1979 else
1980 {
1981 return ColorTargets.Num() > 0;
1982 }
1983 }
1984
1985 FIntPoint GetSize() const
1986 {
1987 const FPooledRenderTargetDesc* Desc = NULL;
1988
1989 if (DepthTarget)
1990 {
1991 Desc = &DepthTarget->GetDesc();
1992 }
1993 else
1994 {
1995 check(ColorTargets.Num() > 0);
1996 Desc = &ColorTargets[0]->GetDesc();
1997 }
1998
1999 return Desc->Extent;
2000 }
2001
2002 int64 ComputeMemorySize() const
2003 {
2004 int64 MemorySize = 0;
2005
2006 for (int32 i = 0; i < ColorTargets.Num(); i++)
2007 {
2008 MemorySize += ColorTargets[i]->ComputeMemorySize();
2009 }
2010
2011 if (DepthTarget)
2012 {
2013 MemorySize += DepthTarget->ComputeMemorySize();
2014 }
2015
2016 return MemorySize;
2017 }
2018
2019 void Release()
2020 {
2021 for (int32 i = 0; i < ColorTargets.Num(); i++)
2022 {
2023 ColorTargets[i] = NULL;
2024 }
2025
2026 ColorTargets.Empty();
2027
2028 DepthTarget = NULL;
2029 }
2030};

2037
2038struct FSortedShadowMaps
2039{
2041 TArray<FSortedShadowMapAtlas,SceneRenderingAllocator> ShadowMapAtlases;
2042
2043 TArray<FSortedShadowMapAtlas,SceneRenderingAllocator> ShadowMapCubemaps;
2044
2045 FSortedShadowMapAtlas PreshadowCache;
2046
2047 TArray<FSortedShadowMapAtlas,SceneRenderingAllocator> TranslucencyShadowMapAtlases;
2048
2049 TArray<FProjectedShadowInfo*, SceneRenderingAllocator> VirtualShadowMapShadows;
2050
2051 TArray<FSortedShadowMapAtlas,SceneRenderingAllocator> CompleteShadowMapAtlases;
2052
2053 void Release();
2054
2055 int64 ComputeMemorySize() const
2056 {
2057 int64 MemorySize = 0;
2058
2059 for (int i = 0; i < ShadowMapAtlases.Num(); i++)
2060 {
2061 MemorySize += ShadowMapAtlases[i].RenderTargets.ComputeMemorySize();
2062 }
2063
2064 for (int i = 0; i < ShadowMapCubemaps.Num(); i++)
2065 {
2066 MemorySize += ShadowMapCubemaps[i].RenderTargets.ComputeMemorySize();
2067 }
2068
2069 MemorySize += PreshadowCache.RenderTargets.ComputeMemorySize();
2070
2071 for (int i = 0; i < TranslucencyShadowMapAtlases.Num(); i++)
2072 {
2073 MemorySize += TranslucencyShadowMapAtlases[i].RenderTargets.ComputeMemorySize();
2074 }
2075
2076 return MemorySize;
2077 }
2078
2079 bool IsEmpty() const
2080 {
2081 return ShadowMapAtlases.IsEmpty() && ShadowMapCubemaps.IsEmpty() && PreshadowCache.Shadows.IsEmpty() && TranslucencyShadowMapAtlases.IsEmpty() &&
2082 VirtualShadowMapShadows.IsEmpty() && CompleteShadowMapAtlases.IsEmpty();
2083 }
2084};

2247 // Provides access to properties of linked scene renderers.
2248
2249 struct
2250 {
2251 FSceneRenderer* Head = nullptr;
2252 FSceneRenderer* Next = nullptr;
2253
2254 } Link;
2255
2256 bool IsHeadLink() const { return Link.Head == this; }
2257
2258 template <typename LambdaType>
2259 void EnumerateLinkedViews(LambdaType&& Lambda, const FSceneView* ViewToSkip = nullptr)
2260 {
2261 for (FSceneRenderer* Renderer = Link.Head; Renderer; Renderer = Renderer->Link.Next)
2262 {
2263 for (FViewInfo& View : Renderer->Views)
2264 {
2265 if (ViewToSkip != &View)
2266 {
2267 if (!Lambda(View))
2268 {
2269 return;
2270 }
2271 }
2272 }
2273 }
2274 }
2275
2276 template <typename LambdaType>
2277 void EnumerateLinkedViewFamilies(LambdaType&& Lambda, const FSceneViewFamily* ViewFamilyToSkip = nullptr)
2278 {
2279 for (FSceneRenderer* Renderer = Link.Head; Renderer; Renderer = Renderer->Link.Next)
2280 {
2281 if (ViewFamilyToSkip != &Renderer->ViewFamily)
2282 {
2283 if (!Lambda(Renderer->ViewFamily))
2284 {
2285 return;
2286 }
2287 }
2288 }
2289 }

2853 template <typename LambdaType>
2854 bool HasAnyShowFlags(LambdaType&& Lambda) const
2855 {
2856 for (FViewFamilyInfo* Family : ViewFamilies)
2857 {
2858 if (Lambda(Family->EngineShowFlags))
2859 {
2860 return true;
2861 }
2862 }
2863 return false;
2864 }

2866 template <typename LambdaType>
2867 void ForEachView(LambdaType&& Lambda) const
2868 {
2869 for (FSceneRenderer* Renderer : Renderers)
2870 {
2871 for (FViewInfo& View : Renderer->Views)
2872 {
2873 if (!Lambda(Renderer, View))
2874 {
2875 return;
2876 }
2877 }
2878 }
2879 }

2892template <typename LambdaType, typename PrerequisiteTaskCollectionType>
2893UE::Tasks::FTask LaunchSceneRenderTask(const TCHAR* DebugName, LambdaType&& Lambda, PrerequisiteTaskCollectionType&& Prerequisites, bool bExecuteInParallelCondition = true, UE::Tasks::ETaskPriority TaskPriority = UE::Tasks::ETaskPriority::High)
2894{
2895 const bool bExecuteInParallel = bExecuteInParallelCondition && FApp::ShouldUseThreadingForPerformance() && GIsThreadedRendering;
2896
2897 return UE::Tasks::Launch(DebugName, [Lambda = Forward<LambdaType&&>(Lambda)] () mutable
2898 {
2899 FTaskTagScope Scope(ETaskTag::EParallelRenderingThread);
2900 Lambda();
2901 },
2902 Forward<PrerequisiteTaskCollectionType&&>(Prerequisites),
2903 TaskPriority,
2904 bExecuteInParallel ? UE::Tasks::EExtendedTaskPriority::None : UE::Tasks::EExtendedTaskPriority::Inline
2905 );
2906}
2907
2908template <typename LambdaType>
2909UE::Tasks::FTask LaunchSceneRenderTask(const TCHAR* DebugName, LambdaType&& Lambda, bool bExecuteInParallelCondition = true, UE::Tasks::ETaskPriority TaskPriority = UE::Tasks::ETaskPriority::High)
2910{
2911 const bool bExecuteInParallel = bExecuteInParallelCondition && FApp::ShouldUseThreadingForPerformance() && GIsThreadedRendering;
2912
2913 return UE::Tasks::Launch(DebugName, [Lambda = Forward<LambdaType&&>(Lambda)] () mutable
2914 {
2915 FTaskTagScope Scope(ETaskTag::EParallelRenderingThread);
2916 Lambda();
2917 },
2918 TaskPriority,
2919 bExecuteInParallel ? UE::Tasks::EExtendedTaskPriority::None : UE::Tasks::EExtendedTaskPriority::Inline
2920 );
2921}

2923template <typename ReturnType, typename LambdaType, typename PrerequisiteTaskCollectionType>
2924UE::Tasks::TTask<ReturnType> LaunchSceneRenderTask(const TCHAR* DebugName, LambdaType&& Lambda, PrerequisiteTaskCollectionType&& Prerequisites, bool bExecuteInParallelCondition = true, UE::Tasks::ETaskPriority TaskPriority = UE::Tasks::ETaskPriority::High)
2925{
2926 const bool bExecuteInParallel = bExecuteInParallelCondition && FApp::ShouldUseThreadingForPerformance() && GIsThreadedRendering;
2927
2928 return UE::Tasks::Launch(DebugName, [Lambda = Forward<LambdaType&&>(Lambda)] () mutable
2929 {
2930 FTaskTagScope Scope(ETaskTag::EParallelRenderingThread);
2931 return Lambda();
2932 },
2933 Forward<PrerequisiteTaskCollectionType&&>(Prerequisites),
2934 TaskPriority,
2935 bExecuteInParallel ? UE::Tasks::EExtendedTaskPriority::None : UE::Tasks::EExtendedTaskPriority::Inline
2936 );
2937}

2939// Creates a FGraphEventRef from UE::Task::FTask prerequisites.
2940template <typename PrerequisiteTaskCollectionType>
2941FGraphEventRef CreateCompatibilityGraphEvent(PrerequisiteTaskCollectionType&& Prerequisites)
2942{
2943 FGraphEventRef GraphEvent = FGraphEvent::CreateGraphEvent();
2944 UE::Tasks::Launch(UE_SOURCE_LOCATION, [GraphEvent]
2945 {
2946 GraphEvent->DispatchSubsequents();
2947
2948 }, Prerequisites, UE::Tasks::ETaskPriority::High, UE::Tasks::EExtendedTaskPriority::Inline);
2949 return GraphEvent;
2950}
